extracted.name: Carrot & parsnip soup
extracted.description: Create a batch of creamy parsnip and carrot soup recipe for a warming lunch or supper. Serve with crusty bread and freeze any leftovers for busy days
ingredient_lines: ½ small bunch thyme leaves picked
3 large carrots peeled and roughly chopped
2 large parsnips peeled and roughly chopped
instruction_lines: Heat the oil in a large saucepan and fry the onion and celery for 10 mins, stirring occasionally until softened. If they start to catch, add a small splash of water. Add the garlic, thyme and ½ tsp black pepper and cook for 2 mins. Add the carrots, parsnips and stock and bring to the boil. Reduce to a simmer and cook for 20 mins until the vegetables are soft, stirring occasionally.
Blend using a stick blender until smooth. Add the cream and blitz again until combined, then taste for seasoning. To serve, ladle into bowls and scatter over a little chopped parsley, if you like.
